option_relations.rationale: Vitamin K-dependent coagulation factor deficiency syndrome is related to pseudoxanthoma elasticum-like disorder with multiple coagulation factor deficiency
Classic pseudoxanthoma elasticum is related to pseudoxanthoma elasticum-like disorder with multiple coagulation factor deficiency
Classical Pseudoxanthoma Elasticum (PXE) is related to pseudoxanthoma elasticum-like disorder with multiple coagulation factor deficiency
Pseudoxanthoma elasticum-like disorder with coagulation deficiency is equivalent to pseudoxanthoma elasticum-like disorder with multiple coagulation factor deficiency
